name: omniroute
description: OmniRoute is an open source AI gateway supporting 230+ LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Mistral, Ollama, and more) with intelligent routing, 4-tier auto-fallback, circuit breaker, semantic cache (Redis-backed), built-in prompt compression (RTK, Caveman, LLMLingua), and a polished dashboard. Acts as a drop-in OpenAI-compatible endpoint for AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Cline, and Open WebUI. Requires a Redis sidecar container for full functionality.

variables.name: REDIS_URL
variables.description: Redis connection string (required for semantic cache and rate limiter; use redis://omniroute-redis:6379 if running the Redis sidecar)

variables.name: OMNIROUTE_ALLOW_PRIVATE_PROVIDER_URLS
variables.description: Allow private/LAN provider URLs (needed for local Ollama, LM Studio, etc.)
